properties.query:
let fenetre = 1h;
let seuil_comptes = 3;
let max_tentatives_par_compte = 5;
let sources_connues = _GetWatchlist('KnownEgressIPs') | project SearchKey;
let echecs =
    union isfuzzy=true
        (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(fenetre)),
        (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(fenetre))
    | where ResultType in ("50126", "50053", "50055", "50056")
    | where IPAddress !in (sources_connues)
    | summarize
        ComptesVises = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
        Tentatives   = count(),
        Comptes      = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 100),
        Applications = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10),
        Protocoles   = make_set(ClientAppUsed, 10),
        Pays         = make_set(Location, 5),
        Debut        = min(TimeGenerated),
        Fin          = max(TimeGenerated)
      by IPAddress;
let succes =
    SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(fenetre)
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | summarize ComptesSucces = make_set(UserPrincipalName, 50) by IPAddress;
echecs
| where ComptesVises >= seuil_comptes
| where (Tentatives * 1.0) / ComptesVises <= max_tentatives_par_compte
| join kind=leftouter succes on IPAddress
| extend ComptesCompromis = set_intersect(ComptesSucces, Comptes)
| extend NbSucces = coalesce(array_length(ComptesCompromis), 0)
| extend Severite = iff(NbSucces > 0, "High", "Medium")
| extend Resume = strcat("Password spray depuis ", IPAddress, " : ", ComptesVises, " comptes visés",
                         iff(NbSucces > 0, strcat(", ", NbSucces, " COMPROMIS"), ", aucun succès"))
| project Debut, Fin, IPAddress, ComptesVises, Tentatives, NbSucces,
          ComptesCompromis, Comptes, Applications, Protocoles, Pays, Severite, Resume
